newsitem.title: UK: BTG up after positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: BTG up after positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in technology group BTG Plc -- already one of the top performing UK stocks this year -- rose on Monday after a Sunday Times report said it should continue to rise and was on track to meet analyst expectations this year.
By 0930 GMT BTG stock had soared 85p to 23.97-1/2p stg -- a rise of 3.7 percent.

BTG last week announced a return to profitability in the six months to September 30 and said it would seek shareholder approval on December 18 to split its ordinary 50p shares into five to improve marketability.
Shares in BTG, whose portfolio includes biotechnology, engineering and business services, have been among the top performing among UK stocks since September 1996.
